proposal.title: Sale of SABIC's 20.62% stake in ALBA to Ma'aden
proposal.body_text: Agreement signed 17 September 2024 by SABIC Industrial Investment Company for the sale of 292,804,000 ALBA shares (20.62%) to Ma'aden; completion announced 19 February 2025 against proceeds of BHD 363 million; SABIC reports a gain of 13 million (Saudi riyals per the report) on disposal.
proposal.withdraw: the batch-01 corporate action sa:2010:divestment:alba-2024 (status 'announced' was incomplete)

evidence.quote: (corresponding to 17 September 2024), the Group announced the signing by SABIC Industrial Investment Company, a wholly owned subsidiary of SABIC, of an agreement for the sale of its holding of 292,804,000 ordinary shares in ALBA (representing 20.62% of its issued share capital) to Saudi Arabian Mining Company (“Ma’aden”).
On 20 Sha’ban 1446H (corresponding to 19 February 2025), SABIC announced the completion of sale of shares in ALBA against sales proceeds of BHD 363 million

metadata.note: My batch-01 action recorded only the 2024 announcement; the same page also states completion on 19 Feb 2025. Counterparty corroboration: reviews/1211-alba-counterparty.json (Ma'aden reports a cash consideration of SAR 3,617m vs SABIC's BHD 363m ≈ SAR 3,612m; difference not explained in either filing).
